ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Bajaj Finance Limited's Board has approved a significant capital raise totaling Rs. 17,500 Crore through two channels: an Rs. 11,700 Crore Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) and an Rs. 5,800 Crore preferential issue of warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv Limited. This substantial equity infusion, pending shareholder and regulatory approvals, will materially dilute existing shareholders' ownership but significantly boost the company's capital base. While the specific use of these funds is not disclosed, the large-scale raise suggests a strategic expansion or strengthening of the balance sheet.
